description: In-Use ACM Certificate Expires Within 45 Days or Is Expired
rationale: An ACM certificate attached to an AWS resource is expired or will expire in the next 45 days. The expiry window is computed from NotAfter using UTC timestamps; missing or unreadable timestamps remain UNKNOWN rather than safe.
remediation: Renew or replace the certificate ahead of expiry, validate SAN coverage for every production hostname, and verify successful attachment and client TLS. Imported certificates require an external/manual renewal process.
